info.name: Kokoland API - Comprehensive Collection
info.description:
# Kokoland API Collection

This collection provides comprehensive documentation and examples for all Kokoland API endpoints.

## Authentication

Most endpoints require JWT Bearer Token authentication. Use the `{{access}}` variable for user tokens or `{{admin_access}}` for admin tokens.

## Base URL

Set the `{{baseUrl}}` variable to your API base URL (default: `https://kokoland.onrender.com`).

## Collection Variables

- `baseUrl`: Base URL for all API requests
- `access`: User access token (JWT)
- `refresh`: User refresh token (JWT)
- `admin_access`: Admin access token (JWT)

## Getting Started

1. Set the `baseUrl` variable
2. Register a new user or login to get tokens
3. Set the `access` and `refresh` variables from the login response
4. Start making authenticated requests

request.description:
Returns a welcome message indicating the API is working.

---

**cURL Example:**

```bash
curl -X GET {{baseUrl}}/
```

item.name: User Management
item.description: Endpoints for user registration, authentication, profile management, and admin user operations.

request.description:
Register a new user account. Returns JWT tokens upon successful registration.

---

**Required Fields:**

- `email`: User email address
- `first_name`: User's first name
- `last_name`: User's last name
- `password`: User password
- `password2`: Password confirmation (must match password)

**Optional Fields:**

- `address`: User address
- `payment_info`: Payment information

---

**cURL Example:**

```bash
curl -X POST {{baseUrl}}/user/register/ \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "first_name": "John",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "password": "password123",
    "password2": "password123"
  }'
```

---

Authenticate a user and receive JWT tokens. Store the `access` and `refresh` tokens in collection variables.

---

**Required Fields:**

- `email`: User email address
- `password`: User password

---

**cURL Example:**

```bash
curl -X POST {{baseUrl}}/user/login/ \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "password": "password123"
  }'
```

---

**Note:** After successful login, update the collection variables:

- Set `access` to the `token.access` value
- Set `refresh` to the `token.refresh` value

---

Retrieve the authenticated user's profile information.

---

**Authentication:** Required - Bearer Token

---

**cURL Example:**

```bash
curl -X GET {{baseUrl}}/user/profile/ \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{access}}"
```

---

Change the authenticated user's password.

---

**Authentication:** Required - Bearer Token

---

**Required Fields:**

- `old_password`: Current password
- `new_password`: New password
- `confirm_password`: Password confirmation (must match new_password)

---

**cURL Example:**

```bash
curl -X PATCH {{baseUrl}}/user/changepassword/ \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{access}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "old_password": "oldpassword123",
    "new_password": "newpassword123",
    "confirm_password": "newpassword123"
  }'
```

---

Logout the authenticated user by blacklisting the refresh token.

---

**Authentication:** Required - Bearer Token

---

**Required Fields:**

- `refresh_token`: The refresh token to blacklist

---

**cURL Example:**

```bash
curl -X POST {{baseUrl}}/user/logout/ \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{access}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "refresh_token": "{{refresh}}"
  }'
```

---

Get the authenticated user's profile data for updating.

---

**Authentication:** Required - Bearer Token

---

**cURL Example:**

```bash
curl -X GET {{baseUrl}}/user/updateprofile/ \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{access}}"
```

---

Update the authenticated user's profile information. All fields are optional.

---

**Authentication:** Required - Bearer Token

---

**cURL Example:**

```bash
curl -X PUT {{baseUrl}}/user/updateprofile/ \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{access}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "first_name": "Updated",
    "last_name": "Name",
    "address": "456 Updated St"
  }'
```

---

response.name: Success Response

---

Delete the authenticated user's account permanently.

---

**Authentication:** Required - Bearer Token

**Warning:** This action cannot be undone.

---

**cURL Example:**

```bash

```

item.name: Book Management
item.description: Endpoints for managing books, customizing books with AI, and retrieving book files and covers.

formdata.description: Child's name to replace character name (required)
Child's photo image file (required) - JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, or TIFF

request.description:
Customize a book by replacing the main character with a child's name and image using AI processing.

---

**Authentication:** Required - Bearer Token

---

**Required Fields:**

- `book`: Book ID
- `child_name`: Child's name to replace character name
- `child_image`: Child's photo image file (JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, or TIFF)

**Optional Fields:**

- `child_age`: Child's age

---

**cURL Example:**

```bash
curl -X POST {{baseUrl}}/books/customize/ \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{access}}" \
  -F "book=1" \
  -F "child_name=Alice" \
  -F "child_age=5" \
  -F "child_image=@/path/to/child_photo.jpg"
```

---

**Note:** This endpoint uses AI to process images and may take some time to complete.

---

request.description:
Add a new book to the catalog.

---

**Authentication:** Required - Bearer Token

---

**Required Fields:**

- `title`: Book title
- `char_name`: Main character name
- `price`: Book price
- `category`: Book category
- `age`: Target age range
- `gender`: Target gender (boy, girl, or unisex)
- `rate`: Book rating
- `description`: Book description
- `book_file`: Book PDF file
- `cover_image`: Book cover image (JPEG, PNG, WebP)

---

**cURL Example:**

```bash
curl -X POST {{baseUrl}}/books/addbook/ \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{access}}" \
  -F "title=New Book Title" \
  -F "char_name=Character Name" \
  -F "price=15.99" \
  -F "category=Fiction" \
  -F "age=6-8" \
  -F "gender=unisex" \
  -F "rate=4.8" \
  -F "description=A wonderful new book" \
  -F "book_file=@/path/to/book.pdf" \
  -F "cover_image=@/path/to/cover.jpg"
```

---

item.name: Admin Endpoints
item.description: Admin-only endpoints for managing purchase requests

request.description:
List all purchase requests for admin processing.

---

**Authentication:** Required - Admin Bearer Token

---

**cURL Example:**

```bash
curl -X GET {{baseUrl}}/buy/admin/requests/ \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{admin_access}}"
```

---

Approve or reject a purchase request. When approved, the book/customization is added to the user's library.

---

**Authentication:** Required - Admin Bearer Token

---

**Path Parameters:**

- `request_id`: Purchase request ID

---

**Required Fields:**

- `action`: Either "approve" or "reject"

---

**cURL Example:**

```bash
curl -X POST {{baseUrl}}/buy/admin/requests/1/process/ \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{admin_access}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "action": "approve"
  }'
```

---
